# mozilla-ca

The Mozilla Public License 2.0 (`LICENSE`), for the root certificates TLS trusts by default:
`src/tls_roots.gen.h`, generated by `tools/gen_tls_roots.mjs` from Node's `tls.rootCertificates`,
which is Mozilla's CA certificate list (NSS's `certdata.txt`). Nothing here is compiled.

The certificates' source form is NSS's `lib/ckfw/builtins/certdata.txt`
(https://hg.mozilla.org/projects/nss), and Node's `src/node_root_certs.h`
(https://github.com/nodejs/node), from which `tls_roots.gen.h` is generated unchanged.
